original_text: Every square is a rectangle. There exist some triangles which are not rectangles. It follows that some triangles are not squares.
There are no metals that are a gas. Every single piece of iron is a metal. It is therefore the case that all iron is a gas.
Every single object can fly. It is known that some boats cannot fly. It follows that some boats are not objects.
Nothing that is a metal is a mammal. Among the creatures that are snakes, there are none that are metals. It must be concluded that no snakes are mammals.
Anything that is clothing is not a shirt. The group of items known as apparel has members that are shirts. It follows that some apparel is not clothing.
Every person who is a doctor is also a medical professional. All medical professionals are people with degrees. We can logically conclude that some people with degrees are doctors.
Some robots are dolphins. Every single dolphin is a fish. It must be true that some fish are robots.
It is true that some roses are yellow. A rose is a type of flower. Thus, some flowers are yellow.
Anything that is a flower is also an insect. There exist some daisies which are not insects. This necessarily means that some daisies are not flowers.
Every single human is a mammal. Everything that is a doctor is a human. It's the case that some doctors are not mammals.
There is no canine that is a feline. Everything that is a canine is also a dog. This makes it true that all dogs are cats.
All things that are cars are fruits. No fruit is a vehicle. This proves that no vehicle is a car.
Some member of the group of fish is not in the group of mammals. At least one dog is a mammal. At least one dog is not a fish.
Every single vehicle can be considered an object. There are no cars that are objects. Therefore, no car is a vehicle.
Items that are tables are in no way items designed for sitting. Everything that is a chair is an item designed for sitting. Chairs cannot be classified as tables.
Some individuals who have degrees are people who work in schools. Some person who works in a school is a teacher. As a result, some teachers are individuals with degrees.
Every person who is a filmmaker is someone who works in production. The set of directors contains someone who works in production. Consequently, every director is a filmmaker.
There are no fish which are mammals. Some reptiles are things that are fish. It follows that some reptiles are mammals.
It is not the case that a pencil is a paper good. Not a single pencil is a book. This makes it true that all books are paper goods.
Anything that is a car is a vehicle. All of the things that are bicycles are vehicles. This means that there are no bicycles that are cars.
Any object that is a house is a building. Some tents are not buildings. This implies that some tents are not houses.
There are no celestial bodies that are giant balls of gas. All stars are giant balls of gas. It follows from this that some stars are not celestial bodies.
It is not the case that every single car is a truck. All cars are vehicles. One can logically conclude that some vehicles are not trucks.
Every fish is a swimmer. There are a number of birds that are swimmers. It follows from this that there are some birds that are fish.
There are no citrus fruits that are berries. Among the berries, a few are fruits. Not all fruits are citrus.
Diamonds are in no way soft substances. Everything that is a diamond is a carbon compound. There are some carbon compounds which are not soft substances.
It is the case that some clouds are white. There are some sheep that are also white. This implies that all sheep are clouds.
Some plants are living things. There are some trees that are plants. It is therefore the case that every tree is a living thing.
A few reptiles are mammals. There are no mammals that are fish. As a result, some fish are reptiles.
Every single creature that is a cat is a fish. A number of tigers are cats. This means that there are some tigers which are fish.
